en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Italian square framed by an archway. At the center stands an ornate fountain topped by a statue holding a trident, in front of a Romanesque cathedral with a rose window, arcades, and a tall octagonal dome. To the left are old multi‑story buildings with shutters and a crenellated medieval palace with a tower. Pedestrians walk around the open square. Handwritten-style caption text appears along the bottom border.
